title: Trust, Rule of Law, and the Size Premium: Evidence from a Meta-Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2609.26212v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reported estimates of the size premium, the tendency of smaller firms to earn higher average returns than larger firms, vary widely across studies, countries, periods, and designs. We examine whether generalized trust and rule of law help account for that heterogeneity. Small firms are more opaque and more dependent on outside finance, so the enforcement and information environment should matter more for them than for large firms. We study 1,613 reported size-slope estimates from 105 studies and 31 countries. The meta-regressions control for study design, specification, precision, publication context, and market and macro-financial conditions; Bayesian model averaging assesses uncertainty over the control set. translated_title: 信任、法治与规模溢价：来自元分析的证据
translated_abstract: 规模溢价是指小公司往往比大公司获得更高的平均回报，但不同研究、国家、时期和研究设计中报告的估计值差异很大。我们考察普遍信任和法治是否有助于解释这种异质性。小公司更加不透明、更依赖外部融资，因此执法和信息环境对它们的影响应比对大公司更大。我们研究了来自105项研究、31个国家的1,613个已报告的规模斜率估计值。元回归控制了研究设计、模型设定、精度、发表背景以及市场和宏观金融条件；贝叶斯模型平均用于评估控制变量集合的不确定性。更稳定的关联是与法治的关联，而且其方向与直觉预期相反：更强的法治与更负的报告规模斜率相关，因而意味着更大的规模溢价。
tldr: 该元分析汇总了105项研究、31个国家的1,613个规模溢价估计值，发现更强的法治反而与更大的规模溢价相关，与直觉预期相反。
